observation_summary: An IllegalStateException is thrown during AST validation because a function expression expected by a getter/setter was replaced by a call node.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the FunctionRewriter incorrectly identifies function expressions within object literal getters/setters as candidates for reduction. When the rewriter attempts to transform these functions, it breaks the structure expected by the AST validator, which enforces that getters/setters must contain specific function nodes. The fix adds a check to ensure that function expressions which are children of a GET or SET node are excluded from the reduction process, preventing the rewriter from corrupting the AST structure of object literal accessors.
